name: Desktop packages
scope: All three native/frontend/host/normal and verification packaging checks; actual installed/packaged Chess/Shogi/Xiangqi GUI regressions on Linux and Windows. macOS CI packages/host only; local macOS Tori QA GUI separately recorded. Not three-platform Tori product GUI acceptance.

Run actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
Run actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
Linux native build dependencies
Install desktop toolchain
Locked frontend and native checks
Verify stable macOS QA identities and external fixture selection
Build normal native package
Inspect macOS application package and run bundled engine
Inspect extracted Debian package and run bundled engine
Install Windows package and run bundled engine
Preserve normal package identity before separate verification build
Install actual Linux application for GUI interaction
Prepare external native GUI driver
Prepare bounded Linux verification proxy and test actual transport boundary
Pin external Windows GUI Python runtime
Prepare matching Windows WebView2 driver and native UI tools
Build separately labeled packaged verification application
Extract Linux verification package with separate identity
Interact with actual installed and packaged Chess Shogi and Xiangqi on Linux
Install separate Windows verification package and interact with actual Chess Shogi and Xiangqi
Upload native package and observations
Post Pin external Windows GUI Python runtime
Post Run actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
